ios.desc:
View stories and comments from Y Combinator's Hacker News on your iPhone or iPod touch. 

Login, vote on stories, and post your own comments. 

Built-in sharing support for...

     ✓  Email
     ✓  Facebook
     ✓  Instapaper
     ✓  Delicious
     ✓  Google Reader
     ✓  Pinboard
     ✓  Read It Later
     ✓  Tumblr
     ✓  Twitter


-

Note: This app is not affiliated with Y Combinator. Hacker News and the YC logo tm Y Combinator.
